title: Procare Attendance Hours Present Leaderboard
dataSources: brightwheel check-ins (`brightwheel:checkin`), Procare attendance (`procare:attendance`), Huckleberry sleep logs (`huckleberry:sleep`), daycare incidents (`daycare:incident`), and nanny timesheets (`nanny:timesheet`).
app: brightwheel check-in exports, Procare attendance logs, Huckleberry sleep tracking, daycare incident reports, and nanny timesheet entries streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=procare:attendance hours_present=*
| stats sum(hours_present) as total_value, avg(hours_present) as avg_value by child_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks child values by total and average hours present across Procare attendance events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `hours_present` values for each Procare attendance event and review total and average hours present by child.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total hours present.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which child shows the biggest hours present numbers in your Procare attendance data.
